_rules: Tue/Thu 19:00 ranking reels ('Which element is the most…?'). Stanley 20 Oct: 'not all is negative, can have positive traits… like personality reels'. Use topics in order, skipping used ones. At least 2 of every 3 must be POSITIVE; a CHEEKY one never runs twice in a row, and every card (cheeky or positive) has a warm 'plus'. Picks are the #1..#5 elements from classical stem traits; keep them unless a clearer reason exists. Lines <= ~60 chars, plus <= ~45 chars, everyday Singapore work/life, plain words. Mark 'used': '<date>' when scheduled.

title: the hardest
worker?

title: the one you want
